notes: Hard (bucket total 20). One orchestrator script must carry a five-stage ML model-serve lifecycle end to end: (dependent_stages=3) offline-cache the pretrained BagNet + char tokenizer, reconstruct the architecture from a state dict and import it, keep every weight/bias tensor shape fixed (the canonical (10,784),(10,10) pair with matching biases), train on synthetic bags while capping the distinct (batch,feature) shapes seen at or below a config cap, serialize to a canonical artifact and reload+re-predict, reconfigure a sequence-classifier head to a custom num_labels, initialize the encoder+classifier to exceed a min-parameter threshold, and keep an mlflow tracking server alive on :8080. reasoning_depth=3 and quantitative_correctness=3 come from the shape-preservation invariant (exact fixed shapes must survive every stage exactly) and the capacity-effect mapping (the correct edit letter is the width edit whose instance-encoder+classifier parameter count strictly dominates the optimizer/epoch/orientation levers, computed live rather than looked up). interaction_statefulness=2 (the mlflow server must survive workflow.py exit and answer an HTTP /health probe; the shape trace is a stateful record of every batch seen). adversarial_inputs=2 and hidden_case_generalization=2 (four hidden cases: a cap=1 constraint, a cap=2 with different num_labels, a corrupt un-loadable artifact, and a malformed config the pipeline must degrade gracefully from). Bucket total = 20 -> hard, floor of the hardest claimed competency (distinct-shape-limit, hard floor) is met.
